ns2:section.sectionText: This course will be an exploration of fabric and fashion as a medium for artists, designers and performers. Utilizing a variety of materials - traditional, non-traditional, found, borrowed, or bought - students will construct identities, disguises, body extensions, and wearable sculptural elements, as well as physical and conceptual connections to their surroundings and to one another. Demonstrations will include various methods of fabric manipulation, with an emphasis on sewing (hand and machine) as a means of construction. In collaboration with the Department of Dance students will create works to be worn for November Dance, a concert to be held at Krannert Center for the Performing Arts.
